workload.definition: campaigns/2026/rq11-nemotron-v030-anchor/workload.json (sha256 d5d794d59bfe0b7615a206f6042c51362b2d667317fa9c0887f8f477a51ee914, predeclared 2026-10-10 and frozen before any run exists; the preflight records its hash and the hash of the anchor corpus results/2026/10/b70-sweep-canary/prompts.json = 566691fae65c6ce40aa31b19614fc40ae8adf1a286a7b33737cf9dbe4f328db9)
workload.cells: battery and canary FIRST (standing-rules 1.3): one discarded same-shape chat warmup, then 6 canaries run A (greedy gen 64), 10 representative tasks (greedy gen 256), 8K two-turn KV-edge check (2 turns, gen 64/turn), 6 canaries run B, deterministic replay 3x3 (batt-arith/batt-logic/batt-json, gen 128, scored-channel sha256 identity); THEN the anchor cells: one discarded same-shape warmup per shape, then for i in 1..5 the interleaved sequence p512-A-i, p512-B-i, p2048-i
workload.anchor_coordinates: p512/g128 with occupied context 512+128 (10 measured requests = 5 A/B pairs) and p2048/g128 with occupied context 2048+128 (5 measured requests); greedy, ignore_eos, finish_reason must be length, completion_tokens must equal 128 exactly
workload.unique_prefixes: every measured/warmup anchor prompt starts with a fresh uuid4 16-hex tag + newline (entropy-first); exact rendered lengths (512/2048) hit by /tokenize binary search and re-verified against usage.prompt_tokens; battery cells use their bare predeclared texts (cache is off, zero-hit deltas still enforced per request)
workload.client: single sequential client (the adapter); one request in flight at a time; C1 only
workload.cache_state: prefix caching OFF (--no-enable-prefix-caching; AGENTS.md 7 / standing-rules 1.4 on the vLLM-XPU W4A16 + speculative stack); /metrics prefix_cache_hits delta must be 0 for every request; the replay groups double as the repeated-prefix cache-off behavioral proof
workload.metric_naming: client post-first tok/s = (completion_tokens - 1) / (last - first content-delta monotonic timestamps), named per benchmark-protocol 9; engine-side decode rate from /metrics request_decode_time deltas kept as a separate corroborating column; DFlash acceptance counters diagnostic only

evidence_rationale: This run is RQ-11's smallest_probe re-anchor, verbatim from the registry: 'Re-measure Nemotron's GPTQ-INT4 + DFlash route on today's harness and metric rules (one n=5 anchor pair)', executed at n=5 over two anchor cells on the pinned v0.30.0 stack (flags per research/2026/v0300-nemotron-gptq64-dflash-n7-serve-source-20261010.md; capture on; prefix cache off per AGENTS.md 7). The result is a NEW baseline: it must never be compared to the historical 186.6 tok/s row (a 2026-08-13 client-post-first n=5 number on a different harness generation). The baseline/candidate comparison schema cannot honestly express a re-anchor because nothing is changed between arms: the question's changed_variable (expert dispatch placement) is this campaign's future lever, not a variable this probe varies. Following the runner-accepted RQ-17 precedent (frozen plan results/2026/10/RQ-17-20261010T171539823866Z-f31436becd/plan.json), the numeric arms are therefore an explicit A/A: baseline = anchor repetition A, candidate = anchor repetition B, same stack, interleaved at the p512/g128 cell, and the assessed metric is per-pair measurement validity, (1 + valid)/2 in each arm, strictly positive so an invalid pair assesses rejected rather than blocked. min_relative_gain is 0.0 (the question's own minimum_relative_gain). The REAL gates live in the four evidence-backed checks: canaries 6/6 correct in both runs, tasks >= 8/10, 8K two-turn correct (quality); replay 3x3 token-identical plus zero cache-hit deltas on every request (correctness); card/daemon/port isolation (isolation); exact token counts, finish=length on all measured cells, capture-on and prefix-cache-off boot evidence, VRAM reserve honored (measurement_validity). The anchor deliverables - per-cell client-post-first medians with range, TTFT/TPOT, DFlash acceptance, measured energy and thermals - are recorded in measurements.json under 'anchor' and raw/anchor_rates.json, and per the ask's declared fallback the ledger registration intended for this run is a SCOPED MANUAL ROW carrying those values; the run's own verdict asserts measurement validity in scope, never a speedup. Attempt accounting: no research.py run has ever executed for RQ-11 (RL-135 and RL-139 were preflight blocks with no run root; the RL-139 cause, a foreign arm.sh/llama-stream loop holding both render nodes, is resolved - dri clients were re-read live 2026-10-10 and list desktop sessions only, and the isolated daemon is up with the pinned digest present), so this plan is the question's first screen attempt with execution_budget.max_attempts=2 intact. Budget: one card (GPU1), one owned container, inside the question's screen_timeout_s=1800 with an internal 1700 s deadline; 34 battery requests + 2 anchor warmups + 15 measured requests plus ~190 /tokenize calibration probes; stop rule: any battery quality failure, replay drift, cache-hit delta, capture-off evidence or VRAM-reserve violation fails its check and the run registers accordingly - no gate is lowered after results.
measurements_note: The adapter reads the frozen plan.json from B70_RUN_DIR and copies metric/unit/identities/controlled verbatim into measurements.json. baseline and candidate are arrays of {pair, value} over the five p512/g128 A/B pairs, value = (1 + valid)/2 per arm (add-one smoothed, strictly positive). The p2048/g128 single-arm samples, per-cell rates, acceptance, energy and thermal coverage are recorded under the 'anchor' key and in raw/anchor_rates.json plus raw/requests.jsonl. checks carry quality, correctness, isolation and measurement_validity, each with a relative evidence file under the run root. The numeric verdict must be read as measurement validity only; the anchor values are the deliverable and are intended for a scoped manual ledger row, not a gain comparison.
